title: 第二十五章 炎帝的火焰转变和友谊的升华第二十六章 新同伴拉鲁拉丝的加入
content_zh:
“恭喜宿主战胜炎帝，奖励金币1000。”
“恭喜宿主收复炎帝，奖励金币1000。”
“系统将进入更新状态，请宿主定时查看。”
“系统跟新成功，开通各种道具功能，请宿主努力向上，赚取金币。”
“恭喜宿主战胜超古代快龙，奖励金币1500。”
“恭喜宿主收复超古代快龙，奖励金币1500。”
“恭喜住宿战胜枯叶道馆训练家，奖励金币500。”
林萧万万没想到，系统居然跟新了，推出了道具功能，而炎帝和巨大快龙帮自己贡献了5000金币，自己毫无所知，看来自己还是太失败，以后一定要多关注系统才行。
金币上了六千，林萧本想购买只宝贝龙，伸手出手后又速度收回。回想自己的小精灵种类和属性，班吉拉：地面、恶系，快龙、巨大快龙：龙系，炎帝：火系，卡咪龟：水系。
如果购买宝贝龙的话，属性就偏向龙系，林萧承认龙系小精灵很强大，自己也很喜欢，属性单一容易被对手利用，这点从渡身上就能看出，每年挑战关东冠军之位，可每次都被科拿克死，全龙系对全冰系，伤不起......
想了想，林萧打开道具功能，入眼的是系统主动帮宿主推荐的道具。
‘地狱果，推荐使用：炎帝，作用：进化出地狱特有的黑色魔焰，具有温度极高、腐蚀、火焰碰到对方能干扰对方精神力等效果。出售价4500金币。’
‘潜力果，推荐使用：快龙，作用：开发出使用小精灵的最大潜力值和成长值。出售价：5000金币，’
‘心灵果，推荐使用：超古代快龙，作用：洗涤它的内心，让它对训练家绝对忠诚。价格：3000金币。’
尼玛！太强大了，林萧口干舌燥，舔舔嘴皮。点上烟，吐着烟圈看着天花板，系统出售的各类道具看得自己眼花缭乱，一时很难下定决心。
林萧最中意的就是地狱果和潜力果，地狱果可以让炎帝火焰进化，潜力果可以把快龙的潜力值成长值开发到最大。
徘徊在两种果实之间，林萧最终咬牙购买了地狱果，如果有可能林萧更愿意买潜力果帮助快龙变强。可服用了潜力果，快龙对林萧的亲密度会变成满值，以后大木博士召唤快龙可定选择听林萧的，这让林萧为难不已，最终林萧舍弃潜力果，购买了地狱果。
一颗紫色爬满黑色斑纹的果实出现在林萧手中，穿上衣服，林萧为芽衣拉好被子，走出旅店，叫出炎帝翻身骑上，“炎帝，到城郊的荒山里去。”
“嗷！”炎帝四腿开动在大街狂奔起来，惹得路人尖叫、咒骂不以，等有人指着林萧方向大喊：“炎帝！”的时候，早没了炎帝的身影。
炎帝用最快的速度来到城郊的荒山里，带林萧下来来双眼灼热的望着他，从一开始炎帝就察觉到林萧身上有让自己感到心悸、渴望的东西。

带林萧拿出地狱果后，炎帝瞪着大眼死死盯着林萧的手，再也移不开眼神，张开的大嘴流出唾液都不曾察觉。
炎帝的猪哥样让林萧感到好笑，心里生出一股恶趣心里，拿着果实做出扔掉的模样。
炎帝的眼神跟着林萧的手打转，急得四爪刨地，焦躁不堪，只能眼巴巴的在林萧身上磨蹭、撒娇。
“好了好了！别闹，好痒！”林萧没好气的拍拍炎帝的大脑袋，“看你急的，喏，拿去吧。”
把果实朝天空扔去，炎帝四蹄用力跳起将地狱果一口吞下，宛如猪八戒吃人生果一样，都不带咀嚼的。
吃下地狱果后，炎帝浑身毛发直立起来，黑烟从毛发下缓缓升起。“嗷！！”地狱果洗涤带来的巨大痛苦让炎帝，前爪刨地，怒声狂吼，随着时间的推移，炎帝身上冒出的有蓝色火焰开始像黑色转变，在黑色的火焰下炎帝显得格外狰狞。
就连林萧都忍不住后退一段距离，那妖艳的黑色火焰，仿佛要将自己一口吞噬。
“嗷！！！！！”
content_en:
"Congratulations to the host for defeating Emperor Yan. The reward is 1,000 gold coins."
"Congratulations to the host for regaining Emperor Yan. The reward is 1,000 gold coins."
"The system will enter the update state, please check it regularly."
"The system has been successfully updated and various prop functions have been activated. Please host to work hard and earn gold coins."
"Congratulations to the host for defeating the super ancient dragon. The reward is 1,500 gold coins."
"Congratulations to the host for recovering the super ancient dragon. The reward is 1,500 gold coins."
"Congratulations to the hotel for defeating the trainer of the Dead Leaf Gym. The reward is 500 gold coins."
Lin Xiao never expected that the system would actually follow the new rules and launch the prop function, and Emperor Yan and the Giant Kuailong contributed 5,000 gold coins to him. He had no idea. It seemed that he was still a failure. He must pay more attention to the system in the future.
The gold coins reached 6,000. Lin Xiao originally wanted to buy a precious dragon, but he reached out and quickly took it back. Thinking back on the types and attributes of your own elf, Bangira: ground, evil type, Kuailong, giant dragon: dragon type, Yandi: fire type, Cammy Turtle: water type.
If you buy a baby dragon, its attributes will be biased toward the dragon type. Lin Xiao admits that the dragon type elves are very powerful and he likes them very much. Single attributes are easy to be exploited by opponents. This can be seen from Watanabe. He challenges the Kanto champion position every year, but he is killed by Konak every time. All dragon types versus all ice types cannot afford to hurt...
After thinking about it, Lin Xiao turned on the props function, and what caught his eye were the props that the system actively recommended to the host.
‘Hell Fruit, recommended use: Emperor Yan, function: evolve the black magic flame unique to hell, which has extremely high temperature, corrosive effects, and can interfere with the opponent’s mental power when the flame touches the opponent. Sold for 4,500 gold coins. ’
‘Potential Fruit, recommended use: Kuailong, function: to develop the maximum potential value and growth value of the elf. Selling price: 5000 gold coins,’
‘Psychic Fruit, recommended use: Super Ancient Kuailong, function: cleanse its heart and make it absolutely loyal to the trainer. Price: 3000 gold coins. ’
Damn it! It was so powerful that Lin Xiao's mouth went dry and he licked his lips. Lighting a cigarette, blowing smoke rings and looking at the ceiling, I was dazzled by the various props sold by the system, and it was difficult to make up my mind for a moment.
Lin Xiao's favorites are the Hell Fruit and the Potential Fruit. The Hell Fruit can evolve the Flame Emperor's Flame, and the Potential Fruit can maximize the growth of Kuailong's potential.
Wandering between the two fruits, Lin Xiao finally gritted his teeth and bought the Hell Fruit. If possible, Lin Xiao would be more willing to buy the Potential Fruit to help Kuailong become stronger. But after taking the Potential Fruit, Kuailong's intimacy with Lin Xiao will reach full value. In the future, when Dr. Omu summons Kuailong, he will definitely choose to listen to Lin Xiao. This makes Lin Xiao embarrassed. In the end, Lin Xiao gave up the Potential Fruit and bought the Hell Fruit.
A purple fruit covered with black markings appeared in Lin Xiao's hand. After putting on his clothes, Lin Xiao pulled the quilt for Mei Yi, walked out of the hotel, called out to Emperor Yan, turned over and rode on, "Emperor Yan, go to the barren mountains on the outskirts of the city."
"Ouch!" Emperor Yan started running wildly on the street, causing passers-by to scream and curse. By the time someone pointed in the direction of Lin Xiao and shouted: "Emperor Yan!", Emperor Yan had long since disappeared.
Emperor Yan came to the barren mountains on the outskirts of the city as quickly as possible, brought Lin Xiao down and looked at him with burning eyes. From the beginning, Emperor Yan noticed that there was something in Lin Xiao that made him feel palpitating and longing.
After leading Lin Xiao to take out the Hell Fruit, Emperor Yan stared at Lin Xiao's hand with his big eyes wide open. He could no longer look away, and he didn't even notice the saliva dripping from his open mouth.
Lin Xiao was amused by Emperor Yan's pig-like behavior, and felt a bad taste in his heart. He took the fruit and pretended to throw it away.
Emperor Yan's eyes followed Lin Xiao's hand, and he was so anxious that he dug his claws on the ground. He was so anxious that he could only rub and act coquettishly on Lin Xiao's body eagerly.
"Okay, okay! Stop making trouble, it's so itchy!" Lin Xiao patted Emperor Yan's big head angrily, "I see you're in a hurry, here,Take it. "
Throwing the fruit into the sky, Emperor Yan jumped up with all his strength and swallowed the hell fruit in one gulp, just like Zhu Bajie eating the human fruit without chewing it.
After eating the Hell Fruit, Emperor Yan's hair stood up all over his body, and black smoke slowly rose from under his hair. "Ouch! ! "The huge pain caused by the hell fruit washing made Emperor Yan dig his front paws on the ground and roar in anger. As time went by, the blue flames coming out of Emperor Yan's body began to turn into black. Under the black flames, Emperor Yan looked particularly ferocious.
Even Lin Xiao couldn't help but retreat a distance. The alluring black flames seemed to be swallowing him up.
"Ouch! ! ! ! ! "
